title: Injection Prevention & Defense-in-Depth Sanitization
learningObjectives: Eliminate SQL Injection using parameterized prepared statements via ORMs and query builders
Prevent Stored and Reflected XSS through contextual HTML/attribute escaping
Sanitize dangerous user inputs (e.g. SVG file uploads, markdown HTML tags)
keyTradeoffs: Raw SQL query control vs parameterized query builder type safety
Stripping HTML tags completely vs allowing an audited whitelist of rich-text tags
commonPitfalls: Concatenating dynamic user input into SQL queries or table/column identifier strings
Using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` in React without running DOMPurify sanitization
transferPrompt: How do defense-in-depth measures like CSP protect users when input sanitization fails?
